STEP 1 - Scene: A side dish or small salad-style plate: shredded lettuce/leafy greens with cooked yellow squash (or yellow zucchini) pieces and a couple of green zucchini slices, with a light dressing or sheen on the greens.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A square white plate, roughly 26 cm across. Area = 3.14 x (13)^2 ≈ 530 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Leafy greens (lettuce, shredded, lightly dressed)
- Yellow squash pieces (cooked, sliced)
- Green zucchini slices

STEP 4 - Area:
- Leafy greens: ~30% of vessel (about 160 cm^2)
- Yellow squash: ~12% (about 64 cm^2)
- Green zucchini: ~3% (about 16 cm^2)
Total food coverage ≈ 45% of the plate.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Leafy greens: 160 cm^2 x 3 cm ≈ 480 ml
- Yellow squash: 64 cm^2 x 2 cm ≈ 128 ml
- Green zucchini: 16 cm^2 x 1.5 cm ≈ 24 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Leafy greens: 480 ml x 0.15 ≈ 72 g
- Yellow squash: 128 ml x 0.6 ≈ 77 g
- Green zucchini: 24 ml x 0.6 ≈ 14 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Leafy greens: 72 g x 20 kcal/100g ≈ 14 kcal
- Yellow squash (cooked): 77 g x 20 kcal/100g ≈ 15 kcal
- Green zucchini: 14 g x 17 kcal/100g ≈ 2 kcal
Total ≈ 31 kcal (dressing not clearly visible, so no added oil counted; a light dressing could add roughly 20–60 kcal).

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 163 g of mostly low-energy vegetables on a large plate with under half coverage is plausible. Total ≈ 163 g, ~31 kcal before any dressing.
